invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.22.0 preserves the completed billing product, exposes Payment Integrations as a first-class Money surface, and routes verified provider-neutral gateway events through the authoritative payment, allocation, invoice-status and Accounting-posting core with retry-safe idempotency, duplicate-reference protection and current permission checks. The release gate includes Invoicing regressions, parity-hardening contracts, quality locks, module migrations, responsive/app UI, ERP integration, TypeScript and production build.
